title: 第49章 过江龙
content_zh:
第49章 过江龙-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

上一章

存书签

下一章

早上七点，沈蔓还没醒。

林川轻手轻脚从床上起来，拉好被角，在玄关换了鞋出门。

车开到震旦国际大楼楼下的时候，他在车里坐了两分钟，把手机上苏晚棠昨晚发过来的授信批复函又看了一遍。

五亿。

白纸黑字，章戳清清楚楚，银行那边一次性过审，条件比预期还宽松。

这笔钱加上公账原有的现金和深圳回笼的尾款，九州创投的可调度资金池，已经逼近十个亿。

十个亿的现金流，在2000年的中国创投圈，是什么概念？

可以说没几个比得上。

林川把手机揣进口袋，推开车门，大步走进大楼。

电梯上到十七层，门一开，走廊里的气氛就不对了。

平时这个点，前台刚开灯，行政还在泡咖啡。今天不一样，所有人都已经到了。

会议室的门敞着，灯亮着，里面能看见苏晚棠正在白板上贴资料，叶知秋坐在长桌一头，面前摊着厚厚一沓财务报表。

周明远也在，

他前天从深圳飞过来的，手里抱着一个牛皮纸文件夹，比平时厚了一倍不止。

林川走进去的时候，所有人的视线都转过来了。

没人说话，但那种绷紧的感觉从每个人的坐姿里透出来。不是紧张，是一种压着兴奋不让它跑出来的克制。

林川把外套搭在椅背上，坐下来，扫了一圈桌面。

授信批复函、资金归集表、项目池图谱、园区阶段规划——四份东西整整齐齐摆在他面前，苏晚棠分得很清楚，每一份右上角都贴了标签。

“都看过了？”

几个人点头。

林川拿起批复函翻了一下，放回去，食指在桌面上点了两下。

“那就不废话了。这五个亿，不是拿来躺账上的，也不是拿来撒的。”

他顿了一下，目光从叶知秋扫到周明远，最后落在苏晚棠身上。

“是拿来抢位置的。”

会议室安静了三秒。

叶知秋第一个开口，她把并表推到桌子中间，声音很稳：“目前的情况我先过一遍。深圳六个项目尾款全部回笼，四千万已经入账。加上公账原有现金、授信到账后的可用额度，我跟财务重新做了一轮并表——”

她用笔尖点了一下最后一行数字。

“可调度资金池，九亿七千四百万。取整数说，接近十个亿。”

这个数字落下去的时候，会议室后排有个年轻研究员手里的笔停了。

他是上个月才入职的，之前在券商研究所干了两年，跳过来的时候觉得九州创投是家有潜力的新公司。

It was seven o'clock in the morning and Shen Man was still awake.

Lin Chuan got up from the bed quietly, pulled up the quilt, changed his shoes in the entrance hall and went out.

When the car drove to the downstairs of Aurora International Building, he sat in the car for two minutes and read again the credit approval letter Su Wantang sent last night on his mobile phone.

Five hundred million.

The writing was in black and white, and the stamps were clear. The bank passed the review in one go, and the conditions were more lenient than expected.

Adding this money to the original cash in the public account and the balance withdrawn from Shenzhen, Jiuzhou Venture Capital's dispatchable capital pool has approached one billion.

What was the concept of a cash flow of one billion in the Chinese venture capital circle in 2000?

It can be said that few can compare with it.

Lin Chuan put his cell phone in his pocket, opened the car door, and strode into the building.

The elevator went up to the seventeenth floor, and as soon as the door opened, the atmosphere in the corridor was different.

Normally at this hour, the lights have just been turned on at the front desk and the administration is still making coffee.Today is different, everyone has already arrived.

The door of the conference room was open and the lights were on. Su Wantang could be seen inside posting information on the whiteboard. Ye Zhiqiu was sitting at the end of the long table with a thick stack of financial statements spread out in front of him.

Zhou Mingyuan is also there,

He flew over from Shenzhen the day before yesterday, holding a kraft paper folder in his hand, which was more than twice as thick as usual.

When Lin Chuan walked in, everyone's eyes turned.

No one spoke, but the tense feeling came from everyone's sitting posture.It's not nervousness, it's a kind of restraint that suppresses excitement and doesn't let it escape.

Lin Chuan put his coat on the back of the chair, sat down, and scanned the table.

Credit approval letter, fund collection form, project pool map, park stage plan - four things were neatly placed in front of him. Su Wantang clearly distinguished them, and each one was labeled in the upper right corner.

"Have you seen it all?"

Several people nodded.

Lin Chuan picked up the approval letter, flipped it over, put it back, and tapped the table twice with his index finger.

"Then let's not talk nonsense. These 500 million are not used to lie on accounts, nor are they used to spread."

He paused, his eyes swept from Ye Zhiqiu to Zhou Mingyuan, and finally fell on Su Wantang.

"It's used to grab positions."

The conference room was quiet for three seconds.

Ye Zhiqiu was the first to speak. She pushed the consolidated statement to the middle of the table and said in a steady voice: "Let me go over the current situation first. All the final payments of the six projects in Shenzhen have been withdrawn, and 40 million has been accounted for. In addition to the original cash in the public account and the available credit limit after the credit is received, I and the finance department made a new round of consolidated statements -"

She tapped the last line of numbers with the tip of her pen.

"The dispatchable capital pool is 974 million. Rounding up, it's close to one billion."

When the number fell, the pen in the hand of a young researcher in the back row of the conference room stopped.

He only joined the company last month. He had worked at the Securities Research Institute for two years before. When he came over, he felt that Jiuzhou Venture Capital was a new company with potential.
